name: FT-891 WAIT Defer (FC-50 scanning)
note: Defers the [WAIT] status overlay so it no longer covers the frequency digits WHILE you turn the main dial. The stock status-overlay builder (0x242b0) paints 'WAIT' over the frequency whenever the ATU gate 0xff202b.0 is set and a WAIT flag is active (0xff2029.6, or 0xff2027.2 && 0xff2011.0) - which, with an FC-50 attached, is exactly while you scan the VFO across a band (each detent re-arms a 25-count WAIT timer). This mod replaces only that WAIT decision block (0x242de..0x242fa) with a cave routine that suppresses WAIT while the main dial is moving, then shows WAIT normally once the dial settles - so the 'tuner is catching up, don't key up yet' cue still appears before TX. Dial motion is detected by watching the raw main-dial counter 0xff23c4 against our own shadow at 0xff8f01 (the firmware's own 0xff200d.3 'dial moved' bit was found to be too transient to gate on); a hold-off counter at 0xff8f00 keeps WAIT suppressed for K display refreshes after the last change so it returns a beat after you stop. Hi-SWR (0xff2013.4) and the entire ATU control state machine are untouched; the TX-side WAIT/inhibit logic is unchanged (display-only mod). The ATU gate at 0x242d4 still guards entry, so with NO FC-50 attached this routine never runs and the image is functionally identical to stock. Both RAM bytes (0xff8f00/0xff8f01) are unused (used RAM ends ~0xff8e37; stack top 0xffc000 grows down). K is a single tunable immediate in the cave (see note on 0x2f2e0). CONFIRMED WORKING on hardware by M5TEA (2026-11-19) on a radio with an FC-50 ATU: the frequency is no longer covered while scanning a band. In his operating he reported seeing no WAIT at all (which suited him); whether WAIT also reappears once the dial settles was not separately confirmed, and the hold-off value K (default 10 refreshes) has not been fine-tuned - adjust it if WAIT flickers during slow tuning or takes too long to return. Contains ONLY the mod author's code; no Yaesu firmware bytes are copied. Apply to your own official firmware .bin. Source: wd_waitcave.s. Requested by M5TEA.

regions.note: Status-overlay builder: replace the WAIT decision block (btst #6,@0xff2029 ...) with jmp wait_cave(0x2f2e0) + 2 NOP. The ATU gate at 0x242d4 and the Hi-SWR path at 0x242c2 are above this and unchanged; the shared draw tail at 0x24302/0x2430a is reused by the cave.

cave: wait_cave (WAIT-defer gate), 96 B. Detects dial motion by diffing raw dial counter 0xff23c4 vs our shadow 0xff8f01; hold-off counter at 0xff8f00. Byte at file 0x2f2f7 (the 0x0a in 'f8 0a mov.b #0x0a,r0l', the 24th byte of this hex = index 23) is K = hold-off in display refreshes after the last dial change; raise it if WAIT flickers during slow tuning, lower it for a snappier return. UNTUNED - no FC-50 was available to calibrate it. Draws WAIT via stock tail 0x24302 ('WAIT' msg 0x2431e) / 0x2430a, exactly as stock once the dial is settled.
